name.description: Base domain name to check, without TLD (e.g. 'acme', 'my-startup'). Can also be a full domain like 'acme.com' — the TLD will be stripped and checked alongside others unless tlds is set.

tlds.description: List of TLDs to check (without dot). Defaults to: com, net, org, io, ai, co, app, dev. Max 10.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Check domain name availability across multiple TLDs (com, net, org, io, ai, co, app, dev by default). Returns per-TLD availability status, registrar, and expiry for registered domains. Uses RDAP — authoritative registry data, no API key. Ideal for brand research, startup naming, and domain portfolio work.
